Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) is the National Standards body of India which has been successfully promoting and nurturing standards in the country since 1947. With over 500 qualified technical and scientific personnel and more than 25,000 experts voluntarily associated with standardization activities, BIS has formulated around 19,000 standards in various technological and industrial areas. Every year, more than 300 new standards and 300 amendments are published.BSB Edge is one of the largest provider of national and international standards in India and the Middle East. With presence in all the major cities of India and a branch office in Dubai, BSB has ensured easy accessibility of standards for its customers.BIS has entered into an exclusive worldwide distribution agreement with BSB to convert, package, duplicate, distribute and market indian standards both on DVD and on-line subscription.
